items.name: job-card
items.title: Job card
items.description: One job in a list — a typed-props display card (logo, title, company, location/type/salary badges, taxonomy chip-links) with no fetching. Shared by the job-search-page and job-detail (Similar jobs) blocks; exports jobDetailPath.
items.docs: Feed each card a PublicJobCard from board.jobs.list()/search(). Links are plain <a> on the canonical paths (jobDetailPath → /companies/{companySlug}/jobs/{jobSlug}) — swap for your router's Link for client navigation.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The shared breadcrumb trail (nav › ol › li) used by the job-detail and salary pages. Pass an ordered items list; a crumb with no href renders as the current page.
items.docs: Render <Breadcrumb items={[{ name, href? }, …]} />. Omit href on the last (current-page) crumb. Links are plain <a> — swap for your router's Link if desired.

items.name: chip-link
items.title: Chip link
items.description: A taxonomy chip that links to a listing route — the shared for category/skill chips on the job card and the job-detail page.
items.docs: Render <ChipLink href="/jobs/{slug}" variant="outline">{name}</ChipLink> (variant secondary|outline). The <a> is a plain path — swap for your router's Link for client navigation.

items.name: job-search-page
items.title: Job search page
items.description: The board's main listing/search surface: heading + count, canonical filter controls (@cavuno/board/filters vocabulary), job cards, load-more. Data in, callbacks out — your loader owns fetching.
items.docs: Fetch with board.jobs.list({ ...filters, cursor, limit: 20 }) (board.jobs.search() when q is set). onFiltersChange → write filters to URL search params and refetch; onLoadMore → refetch with nextCursor and append. Links are plain <a> on the canonical paths — swap for your router's Link for client navigation.

items.name: job-detail
items.title: Job detail page
items.description: Full job page: breadcrumbs, header badges, facts, taxonomy chips, operator custom fields (CAV-294), sanitized description, company block, similar jobs. Server-renderable; apply/alert controls arrive via slots.
items.docs: Load with board.jobs.retrieve(jobSlug) + board.jobs.similar(jobSlug). Pass @cavuno/apply-flow's ApplyButton through `actions` and @cavuno/alert-signup's form through `alertSlot`. Render JSON-LD (createJobPostingJsonLd from @cavuno/board/seo) in your route's head — head management is framework-specific.

items.name: apply-flow
items.title: Apply flow
items.description: Native apply (ADR-0054) with the hosted board's exact fallback ladder: external-only jobs, anonymous visitors, unverified candidates, verified native apply. Idempotent against the Board API.
items.docs: Wire onApply to board.jobs.apply(jobSlug) with an authenticated client (or a server function forwarding the session bearer). viewer comes from your session state; the auth/verify/applications hrefs point at your app's routes.

items.name: alert-signup
items.title: Job-alert signup
items.description: Double-opt-in job-alert subscribe form (email + weekly frequency); the search/job context rides in as filters, matching the hosted capture form. Honest duplicate handling.
items.docs: Wire onSubscribe to board.jobAlerts.subscribe(input) (client-side) or a server function forwarding it. The API is idempotent per (email, filters) and returns created | duplicate.

items.name: salary-page
items.title: Salary page sections
items.description: The salary-page building blocks (ADR-0041): headline range card with percentiles, by-seniority comparison table, cross-link rails, FAQ, breadcrumb — typed against the board.salaries.* wire shapes.
items.docs: Feed from board.salaries.titles.get(slug) (and the skills/locations/companies twins): overall → OverallSalaryCard, bySeniority → SenioritySalaryTable, index lists → SalaryRail items with your salary-route hrefs.
